_meta.description: Full trade-by-trade intelligence: entry price, exit price, P&L, whether still rising at exit. Jarvis uses this to build a winning formula.

exit_quality_analysis.description: Did we leave money on the table or catch it right?
exit_quality_analysis.tp_full_exit_win_rate: 100% — every trade that reached full TP was profitable
exit_quality_analysis.insight: Of 111 losses, 24 (22%) were rugs. The remaining 76 were normal SL exits. Rugs are the dominant loss driver.
exit_quality_analysis.early_exit_insight: Manual closes and stall exits sometimes left upside on table but protected capital.

pumpswap_graduation_snipe.description: The consistently profitable pattern — grad-snipe on PumpSwap

win_template.entry: 0.05 SOL immediately after pump.fun graduation detection

pump_fun_bc_snipe.description: A2 bonding curve snipe — higher risk, lower WR
pump_fun_bc_snipe.insight: BC snipe wins are real (avg +58%) but rug rate is high. Entry quality gate (score≥65, social checks) is the right lever.

what_every_winner_had: Score ≥17 for pumpswap grad-snipe OR score=12 for pump.fun BC (different scales)
Exit reached TP — never a SL exit
Entry within tight window (grad-snipe: within 60s of graduation detection)
Liquidity present at entry (pumpswap: ≥$14K, BC: real_sol ≥1.5)
what_every_loser_had: Either a rug (token crashed >50% suddenly) or normal market stop-loss
SL exits: token declined gradually to -9% threshold
No clear score pattern — rugs can score 15+ and still rug
jarvis_formula_inputs.the_edge: Grad-snipe (Strategy B) has the cleanest pattern: fast detection + score≥17 + tp_full_exit = near-100% win rate on qualified entries. The bottleneck is ENTRY QUALITY not exit strategy.
